# FRDTLAB

> FRDTLAB is a systems & intelligence lab for marketing: helping brands and small businesses win in AI-era search, integrated growth, and marketing infrastructure. Founded by Amanda Friedt (professionally also known as Amanda Farley), a Detroit-based growth and marketing operator, speaker at SMX, Pubcon, Hero Conf, and brightonSEO; 4x 2026 US Search Awards winner for programs she led.

## Start here
- [The Lab (home)](https://frdtlab.com/): What FRDTLAB is and how it builds.
- [Frameworks](https://frdtlab.com/frameworks): The Integrated Marketing Intelligence System and the signal-flow model: marketing through the system, not on top of it.
- [In Motion](https://frdtlab.com/in-motion): Events, appearances, press, and recognition.
- [Work With Me](https://frdtlab.com/work-with-me): Advisory, workshops, and speaking.
- [About Amanda Friedt](https://frdtlab.com/about): Founder profile: who Amanda Friedt (also known as Amanda Farley) is, the two brands (FRDTLAB + The Unapologetic Leader), and what she does.

## Guides, tools, and proof
- [AI Search Visibility guide](https://frdtlab.com/ai-search-visibility): What AI search visibility is, how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and AI Overviews pick sources, how to track it, and a 30-day plan.
- [Analytics Coverage Calculator](https://frdtlab.com/analytics-coverage-calculator): Free tool. Compare analytics-reported revenue with actual revenue to see what share your tracking sees.
- [Sample report](https://frdtlab.com/sample-report): Illustrative FRDTLAB monthly report: lane scoreboard, data currency box, platform watch.
- [Case study: marketplace returns](https://frdtlab.com/case-study-amazon-returns): Anonymized. Fitment copy cut one listing's return rate from 12.96% to 3.13%; an untouched control rose 1.96 pts.
- [Field note: Marketing through the system](https://frdtlab.com/field-note-marketing-through-the-system): The six-stage AI operating layer explained in PPC and SEO terms.
- [The Autonomy Gradient](https://frdtlab.com/frameworks#autonomy-gradient): Five autonomy tiers for AI agents; reversibility is the line.
- [The Validation Loop](https://frdtlab.com/frameworks#validation-loop): Paid, organic, and real-sales data; two or more sources must agree before a decision ships.
- [Agent Governance Builder Kit](https://frdtlab.com/agent-governance-kit): $47 kit, early access. Worksheet, templates, and stress tests that become a written permission policy for AI agents.

## Services
- [The Foundry - SMB growth system](https://frdtlab.com/foundry): Done-with-you growth system install for small businesses, scoped by trade.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://frdtlab.com/ai-visibility-audit): Cross-channel audit of what is working, what is breaking, and where the highest-value opportunities are hiding. $497 for one brand, $1,250 with competitor benchmarking. One week.
- [Workshops and Trainings](https://frdtlab.com/workshops): Executive and team sessions on agentic marketing, search evolution, AI visibility, and growth systems.
- [Fractional CMO / VP of Growth](https://frdtlab.com/fractional-cmo): Senior marketing leadership part-time for companies at $1M to $50M: growth strategy plus the operating system underneath it. $5,000 to $15,000/month. Detroit-rooted, remote across the US.
- [Fractional CMO in Detroit](https://frdtlab.com/fractional-cmo-detroit): Detroit-rooted fractional CMO / VP of Growth for Detroit and Michigan companies: in person locally, remote across the US. $5,000 to $15,000/month.
- [AI Adoption for Marketing Teams](https://frdtlab.com/ai-adoption): Put AI to real work: campaign, content, reporting, and QA workflows with prompts, guardrails, and SOPs. $8,000 to $25,000/project.
- [PPC Management with SEO built in](https://frdtlab.com/ppc-management): Google Ads and Meta Ads management with SEO read alongside. Read-first onboarding in five stages (Sense, Structure, Build, Measure, Compound), waste removed within two weeks, conversion tracking rebuilt around real leads, then test-and-learn management. The client approves every budget and bid change. Detroit-rooted, remote across the US.
- [Marketing Operations & Systems](https://frdtlab.com/marketing-ops): Stack audit plus a connected, AI-ready marketing operating system. Audit $2,500, build $10,000 to $30,000.

## Author
Amanda Friedt, also known as Amanda Farley. Detroit-based growth & marketing leader specializing in paid search, SEO, and AI-era (generative engine) optimization. Founder of FRDTLAB, creator of Unapologetic Leadership. LinkedIn: amandafriedt. Two decades in integrated marketing and AI-era search.
